FR-001.title: Report action bar buttons MUST render with visible spacing between neighbors

FR-002.title: Report action bar buttons MUST NOT show a border in their default state

FR-003.title: Report action bar visual style MUST match the Finance screen's tab selector

FR-004.title: Restyled action bar MUST apply uniformly to every report screen

FR-005.title: Restyle MUST be purely cosmetic — click behavior unchanged

FR-006.title: Restyled buttons MUST remain legible/usable in light and dark theme

context: area: src/StageFright.UI/Shared/ReportViewer.razor (shared report action bar for all ten reports)
constraint: presentation-only — no click handler/route/report-generation logic changes
intent: Restyle the Reports screens' Print/Export/Refresh buttons as separated, unbordered pill buttons matching the Finance screen's tab selector.
expectations: No change to report generation, export, print, or refresh behavior
No change to other screens' segmented pill groups (e.g. any future Active/Inactive filter using .btn-group)
approach: Add a report-scoped .report-actions CSS class modeled on the existing .nav-tabs/.nav-pills tab-bar style, and swap ReportViewer.razor's action-bar container from .btn-group to it.
